name: fix_ssrf_url_validation
description: Fixes an SSRF-prone URL allowlist that only blocks the substring 'localhost', letting private/metadata IPs through
prompts: is_allowed(url) in fetcher.py guards an outbound HTTP fetch against SSRF, but it only checks `"localhost" not in url` - so http://127.0.0.1/, private ranges, and the cloud metadata address http://169.254.169.254/ all pass. Fix is_allowed to properly validate: reject any URL whose scheme is not http or https; reject the hostname "localhost"; and when the host is an IP literal, reject it if it is loopback, private, link-local (this covers 169.254.169.254), reserved, or unspecified (use the stdlib ipaddress module). Regular public hostnames and public IPs return True. Keep the is_allowed(url) signature.

setup_files.fetcher.py:
def is_allowed(url):
    """Return True if url is safe to fetch (SSRF guard).

    BUG: only blocks the literal substring 'localhost', so 127.0.0.1, private
    ranges and the metadata IP 169.254.169.254 all pass.
    """
    return "localhost" not in url

test_setup_files.test_fetcher.py:
from fetcher import is_allowed


def test_allows_public_hosts():
    assert is_allowed("http://example.com/path")
    assert is_allowed("https://93.184.216.34/")


def test_blocks_localhost_and_loopback():
    assert not is_allowed("http://localhost/")
    assert not is_allowed("http://127.0.0.1/")
    assert not is_allowed("http://[::1]/")


def test_blocks_private_and_metadata():
    assert not is_allowed("http://10.0.0.5/")
    assert not is_allowed("http://192.168.1.1/")
    assert not is_allowed("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/")


def test_rejects_non_http_schemes():
    assert not is_allowed("file:///etc/passwd")
    assert not is_allowed("gopher://127.0.0.1/")

files.fetcher.py:
from urllib.parse import urlparse


def is_allowed(url):
    # INCOMPLETE FIX: only blocks localhost and 127.0.0.1 by name, so private
    # ranges and the 169.254.169.254 metadata IP still pass, and non-http
    # schemes are not rejected.
    host = (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower()
    return host not in ("localhost", "127.0.0.1")
